items.title: 中国广西新发现直立人化石 将助力破解古人类演化关键谜题
items.summary: 中新网北京11月19日电 (记者 孙自法)直立人是生存年代最长的古人类物种之一，已知在约190万年到10.8万年前分布在整个非洲到欧亚大陆东部。不过，由于此前中国特别是华南地区相关化石记录存在空白，成为古人类演化关键谜题之一，备受关注。
items.titleEn: China's Guangxi, newly discovered fossils of upright humans will help solve key puzzles in ancient human evolution
items.summaryEn: In the early days of the ancient world, the first known species of primates was known to have lived from about 1.9 million to 10.8 million years ago, spreading across Africa and into eastern Eurasia. However, due to the gap in the fossil record of ancient China, especially in the southern Chinese region, it has become one of the key puzzles of ancient human evolution.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
